page.notes: Hebrew and Arabic lines are uncertain in places and should be checked against the scan: the Hebrew in the first paragraph (אלו הערביים הטפשים האוילים השטופים כומה) and the Arabic lines, especially the one after "gradum exprimeret" and the Fuerunt line (اتا الفقه). Marginal notes "Hal. Tesb. c. 8." and "Cenzel' Afra r." are partly unclear. The first paragraph begins mid-sentence and is marked as a continuation. The Arabic and Hebrew lines are transcribed by eye and may contain errors. The Latin "Mohammede" and "Ebn Anasi" are read as printed. The catchword "juris" is the last word of the page.
